alternative: Anna Aveiro Nakamura dos Santos Moreira Cuccittini

node.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

A first-year high school student. Born and raised in Brazil, her mother is Japanese. She's a mood maker, assertive, and doesn't hesitate to speak her mind. She's skilled in capoeira, which she learned as a self-defense technique, and loves music.

**Height:** 160 cm

A second-year student at Takanosaki High School. She's the captain of the powerful cheerleading club, and a skilled player who built the team from a lack of a dedicated coach to becoming a regular at the nationals in just one year. She's responsible for managing the entire team and even the budget. While clumsy, she puts her teammates first, though it's unclear if she communicates this.

__Height:__ 155 cm

A first-year student at Omaebashi High School. She loves yoga, India, and philosophy. She doesn't like being overwhelmed and lives for peace and quiet, but she's constantly at the mercy of her childhood friend, [Anna](https://anilist.co/character/324909/Anna-Aveiro). Her delusional nature causes her to engage in rambling delusions that rival those of Bollywood.

__Height:__ 145 cm

First-year student at Sakurajo Girls' High School. External student. Expressionless, taciturn, and extremely rational. She often gets talked about on social media for doing parkour to shorten her commute. In fact, she's not very dexterous, having trouble splitting chopsticks properly or tying sneaker laces properly.

__Height:__ 173 cm

First-year student at Sakurajo Girls' Academy High School. An internal student. A sheltered young lady with a father who is the next director of a general hospital and a mother who is a former model. A tall and accomplished rhythmic gymnast, she is known as the "Fairy of Numata." Her earnest, humble, hardworking, and kind nature have earned her a devoted fanbase at school.

__Height:__ 155 cm

A first-year high school student. She's cheerful, energetic, and loves cheerleading. Despite her bad luck, she's an exceptional athlete and won the national cheerleading championship in middle school. She and her best friend, [Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/324911/Megumi-Kaionji), are aiming to win the national cheerleading championship in high school as well.

__Height:__ 158cm

The daughter of Shurinji Temple, a temple in Numata. In middle school, she was captain of the cheerleading club, but was hospitalized due to illness during a tournament. She is currently undergoing rehabilitation and recuperating at home. To fulfill her promise to [Kanata](https://anilist.co/character/324907/Kanata-Misora), she is a hard worker who studies diligently in order to transfer to Takanosaki High School. She is responsible and caring, but also has a tendency to tease Kanata. She is skilled at coming up with practice schedules and performances.

A second-year student at Takanosaki High School. She started cheerleading in high school and, through steady effort, has risen to the A team. She is very caring and tutors her juniors, including [Kanata](https://anilist.co/character/324907/Kanata-Misora), not only in cheerleading but also in academics. Currently, for some reason, she serves as a practice assistant.

__Height:__ 168 cm

Miyabi is a specialist in dance and tumbling who captivates audiences. A self-proclaimed dance enthusiast recognized by all for studying various dance forms like contemporary dance and classical dance to expand their solo repertoire. Possesses a realistic and severe side.

**Height**: 175 cm

A second-year student at Takanosaki High School. Tall and with a model-like figure, [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/339769/Hana-Nabatame) hates standing next to her. Despite her calm personality, she takes extra pride in supporting the team as a base. She remains unfazed even in times of crisis.

**Height**: 142 cm

A second-year student at Takanosaki High School. She is the star of the cheerleading team. While selfish and proud, she has a passionate personality and never stops working hard to remain the A-Team's leader. She has an angelic smile during performances and a strict, fiery attitude during practice, but she never forgets to be grateful to those around her, believing that "the top members can shine thanks to the supporters and spotlights."
